final_text:
Result: the task-rewriting trick didn't help, and it cost a lot more.

We ran 48 tests. The share of accepted answers didn't go up. Paid token use more than doubled, so our bill would roughly double too.

Caveat: this test can't prove the trick is useless. The tasks were too easy, so the agent mostly succeeded without it. There was little room to improve, and any gain would have been hidden.

So we know the cost is real, and we don't know whether the benefit is.

Options:
1. Drop the trick. This is cheapest and safe.
2. Re-test on harder tasks. It costs a bit more, but it's the only way to learn if it ever pays off.

I recommend option 2, kept small, and we only adopt the trick if it clearly wins. Want me to go ahead?
